renewal_term.value_raw: successive terms of one (1) year each
renewal_term.quote: this Agreement shall automatically renew for successive terms of one (1) year each (each a "Renewal Term")

notice_period_to_terminate_renewal.value_raw: at least thirty (30) days prior to the expiration
notice_period_to_terminate_renewal.quote: unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least thirty (30) days prior to the expiration of the then-current term

governing_law.quote: This Agreement and any dispute arising out of or in connection with it shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Dubai International Financial Centre ("DIFC").

termination_for_convenience.value_raw: Either party may terminate this Agreement at any time without cause upon sixty (60) days prior written notice
termination_for_convenience.quote: Either party may terminate this Agreement at any time without cause upon sixty (60) days prior written notice to the other party.

cap_on_liability.quote: In no event shall either party's aggregate cumulative liability arising out of or related to this Agreement exceed the sum of USD 100,000 (one hundred thousand United States Dollars).
